g.text: ‘Percy Jackson’ Stars on Learning to Scream and Sob on Set of Season 3: ‘I Love Playing the Dark Type of Scenes’ ◆ Joshua Jackson Teases ‘Sex, Drugs and Rock ‘n’ Roll’ in New HBO Max Series ‘How to Survive Without Me’: ‘I’m Getting Too Old For This S—’ ◆ Jack Nicholson Has ‘Disappeared’ but Is ‘Well,’ Says Michael Douglas: ‘I Still See Him’ ◆ Ken Russell’s ‘The Devils’ Feels More Relevant Than It Did 55 Years Ago. That’s Because It’s About a World Gone Mad ◆ Best Celebrity Halloween Costumes: Kim Kardashian as North West, Paris Hilton as Britney Spears and More ◆ Producer Will Packer Stumps to Get Out the Vote and Launch a Private HBCU Fundraising Campaign ◆
